descriptions.en: The Acrid fires an acidic-infused needle.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ACRID）阿克里德可以射出注满强酸的刺针。

descriptions.en: While its intended design is for deep space construction, the concentrated laser beam of the Spectra is highly effective against organic and synthetic enemies.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SPECTRA）虽然它原本设计给太空中的工程师，光谱切割器的集中激光对有机和合成敌人也非常有效。

descriptions.en: This reengineered Cycron features a refracting energy disc that can split off the main target, hitting up to 2 additional nearby targets.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TENET CYCRON）这款重新设计的循环离子枪拥有一个折射能量盘，光束射击可以从主要目标上分离，最多击中附近的两个额外目标。

descriptions.en: Parvos Granum's engineers have made this already ferocious hand cannon even more deadly with the addition of an alternate fire mode that empties an entire clip in one devastating burst.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TENET DETRON）帕尔沃斯·格拉努的工程师们为这把已经十分凶猛的手炮增加了一种新的射击模式，在一次毁灭性的爆发中清空整个弹匣，使这把武器更加致命。

descriptions.en: Alternate fire on this reengineered Plinx fires a projectile that pulls enemies close and then explodes. Its cooldown increases after the explosion to accommodate battery power demands.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TENET PLINX）这把重新设计的漫射者可以使用次要射击发射一枚投射物将敌人拉近然后爆炸。爆炸后冷却时间会增加以满足电池的电量需求。

descriptions.en: The sleek lines of the Detron conceal its ferocious nature. The hand cannon's semi-automatic action takes down enemies with speed and efficiency.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DETRON）德特昂的流线型线条掩饰其凶残本性，这把半自动手枪是快速并有效率地击倒敌人。

descriptions.en: Compact and deadly, the Cestra discharges bolts of energy at an increasingly rapid rate.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CESTRA）小巧而致命的锡斯特，以越来越快的射速释放能量弹。

descriptions.en: Wield two Cestras to unleash a dual torrent of high energy bolts.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DUAL CESTRA）双手各持一把锡斯特释放出双流高能量弹幕。

descriptions.en: A special-order Corpus cutting tool for master crafters only. Features distinctive azurite plating and a focusing crystal of precision clarity and cut.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SPECTRA VANDAL）一把特殊订制的 Corpus 切割工具，只适用于大师级工匠。具有独特的蓝铜色电镀外观和用于精准清澈化以及切割的聚焦水晶。

descriptions.en: Blasts targets with a massive wave of sonic energy. Results reported to be: 'Very Satisfying'.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SONICOR）以巨大的声波能量震飞目标。使用报告的结果是：非常爽。

descriptions.en: Itemize and execute with this pair of auto-lock-on, homing-projectile pistols. Shoot from-hip for a more conventional pistol experience. The patented Granum Attaché System reloads the pistols when holstered.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TENET DIPLOS）用这对自动锁定追踪目标的双枪将敌人逐个击破。腰射模式与传统手枪无异。配备了获得专利批准的格拉努公文包系统，收起时自动装填。

descriptions.en: Forgo ammunition with the regenerating energy disc in this plasma throwing pistol.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CYCRON）用这把装有能量恢复圆盘的等离子体发射手枪摆脱弹药的限制。

descriptions.en: Send a massive charge of potential energy hurling toward unfortunate targets.
descriptions.zh: （英文：STATICOR）将强大的静电势能射向不幸的敌人。

descriptions.en: Capable of firing multiple rockets at once, the Angstrum is a handheld instrument of destruction.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ANGSTRUM）能够同时发射若干火箭的安格斯壮是一个手持的毁灭工具。

descriptions.en: Imbued with the finest Prisma crystal, this refined Angstrum features boosted charge and reload speeds.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PRISMA ANGSTRUM）灌注了最出色的棱晶，这款经过精制后的安格斯壮的特点是具有更快的蓄力和装填速度。

descriptions.en: Dominate rivals with this pistol’s lightning fast rail-slugs. Head-shots speed up reload.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TENET SPIREX）用这把手枪快如闪电的弹道压制对手。爆头可加快装填速度。

descriptions.en: Sentient tech merges with Corpus design to deliver this lethal sidearm. Fully automatic, it fires ricocheting, homing projectiles that release small clouds of <DT_GAS_COLOR>Gas on impact. Alt-fire to release the entire magazine without homing as a single burst.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CYANEX）Sentient 科技与 Corpus 设计的结合，发展出这款致命的次要武器。该武器为全自动，可射出跳飞式、自动导引的弹幕，子弹在撞击时会释放出小一股 <DT_GAS_COLOR>毒气。次要射击为可在单次射击中释放剩余的弹药。

descriptions.en: A weapon that reaches for its next victim even as it kills. With each takedown, this pistol spawns an energy tendril that reaches for a nearby target.
descriptions.zh: （英文：OCUCOR）在击杀同时便已准备好对下一名受害者伸出魔爪的一种武器。每次击杀，这把手枪会生成能量卷须伸向邻近目标。

descriptions.en: Cultivate a meaningful relationship with this deceptively simple battery-powered pistol. The Plinx rewards attention and investment from the wise.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PLINX）与这把看似朴素的电池手枪培养出深厚的情感。漫射者最能回馈来自智者的关注与投资。

descriptions.en: This scoped pistol analyzes strikes, learning how to damage its targets most effectively. Achieve maximum damage output after five successive hits.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ARCA SCISCO）这把带有瞄准镜的手枪会分析着弹，获悉如何更有效的对目标造成伤害。在连续成功命中五次后会达到最大的伤害输出。

descriptions.en: Designed as a pair, these Grineer sidearms fire projectiles at a slower rate but with greater force and accuracy.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TWIN GREMLINS）这把 Grineer 随身武器被设计成一对，虽然开火速度较慢，但有更强大的火力和准确性。

descriptions.en: A full-auto pistol known as the most compact and lightweight weapon of the Grineer arsenal. Though it has a small Magazine Capacity, the Viper has a very high Fire Rate and ultra-fast reload times thanks to a simplified magazine design.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VIPER）Grineer 军械库中小巧轻便的代名词。蝰蛇是一把弹匣容量细小的全自动手枪，其精简化的弹匣为其带来高射速及惊人的重新装填速度。

descriptions.en: The Kraken is a heavy pistol of Grineer design that fires two quick shots with a single pull of the trigger. Skilled marksmen will appreciate the value in this deadly accurate weapon.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KRAKEN）北海巨妖是一把由 Grineer 设计、手感沉重的手枪，单扣扳机可迅速击出两连发射击。熟练的神枪手一定懂得这把致命精准武器的价值。

descriptions.en: Captain Vor's prized Orokin-Grineer hybrid pistol has an average rate of fire, but it has high damage and superior zoom capabilities.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SEER）奥罗金-Grineer 复合式手枪是沃尔上尉最重要的手枪，虽只有一般射速，但具有高杀伤力和卓越的狙击能力。

descriptions.en: This Lich-variant semi-automatic hand cannon delivers a lot of punch in a small package. Higher fire rate, magazine capacity and reload speed.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA BRAKK）这把玄骸变体的半自动手枪，小型的枪身中却拥有强大的冲击力。它拥有更高的射速、更大的弹匣容量以及更快的装填速度

descriptions.en: A custom variant that fires three quick shots with a single pull of the trigger, or can alt-fire burst the remainder of its magazine. Higher Fire Rate, Magazine Capacity and Reload Speed.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA KRAKEN）一种北海巨妖的改装变体，单扣扳机可迅速击出三连发射击，或者可通过次要射击来进行点射。它拥有更高的射速、更大的弹匣容量以及更快的装填速度

descriptions.en: A highly-optimized Nukor that allows for the weapon’s microwave field to hit up to two additional targets.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA NUKOR）一把高度优化的努寇微波枪，可以通过其微波场击中最多两个额外目标。

descriptions.en: This variant pistol has higher fire rate and magazine capacity. Superior zoom capabilities plus projectiles have a small Corrosive burst.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA SEER）这把变体手枪拥有更高的射速、弹匣容量以及变焦倍率。此外，它射出的子弹还会产生小范围腐蚀爆炸效果。

descriptions.en: Double-fist rapid-fire bursts of pain with these dual-wield variants of the Grineer submachine gun. Higher Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA TWIN STUBBAS）用这把 Grineer 冲锋枪双持变体的爆发速射特性来产生双倍的苦痛。它拥有更高的射速和更大的弹匣容量。

descriptions.en: When one Grakata isn't enough, bring another for extra firepower.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TWIN GRAKATAS）一把葛拉卡达手枪不敷需求时，不妨再带上一把享受额外的火力吧。

descriptions.en: Fused with prisma crystals, these pristine Grineer sidearms are sure to intimidate any foe.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PRISMA TWIN GREMLINS）熔合了棱晶，这崭新的 Grineer 随身武器能恐吓到任何敌人。

descriptions.en: Firing a sticky, toxic, explosive compound, the Stug Gel Gun offers multiple ejection modes, delivering maximum damage in all situations.
descriptions.zh: （英文：STUG）史特克凝胶枪能发射出一种粘稠、有毒的爆炸混合物。且具有多种发射模式，在各种情况下都能造成最大伤害。

descriptions.en: Simple but powerful. The semi-automatic Brakk hand cannon delivers a lot of punch in a small package.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BRAKK）简单但威力强大，半自动布拉克手枪小型的枪身中却拥有强大的冲击火力。

descriptions.en: The Marelok combines the stopping power of a rifle with the portability of a pistol.
descriptions.zh: （英文：MARELOK）玛瑞火枪因为后坐力高而缺乏准度。

descriptions.en: Creates and focuses a high-frequency field of microwaves, literally cooking the target from within.
descriptions.zh: （英文：NUKOR）创造并聚焦一个高频率的微波场，从内部将目标确确实实地烤熟。

descriptions.en: A compact four-barreled design packing a self-charging capacitor that discharges upon every reload from empty. Features auto hip-fire and aimed fire is semi-auto, four-shot instant burst.
descriptions.zh: （英文：QUATZ）拥有紧凑的四管设计且装有一个自充电电容器，会在空枪装填时释放电流。腰射时为自动模式，瞄准时为瞬间射出四发子弹模式。

descriptions.en: Doubling their volley on each successive shot, the Twin Kohmaks decimate foes in seconds.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TWIN KOHMAK）每次连续击发都有双倍的齐射子弹，双子寇恩霰机枪能够在数秒之内消灭敌人。

descriptions.en: Like the larger Kohm, this hand-shotgun doubles its volley with each successive shot.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KOHMAK）像稍大的寇恩热能枪，这把手持霰弹枪连续射击时都会加倍射出能量弹。

descriptions.en: The sidearm of choice for Prime Grineer warriors, Sagek Prime blends Grineer brutality with Orokin aesthetics. When Sagek Prime inflicts a critical hit, its next shot has a chance to gain significant Status Chance.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SAGEK PRIME）作为精英 Grineer 战士的首选次要武器，杀格 Prime 融合了 Grineer 的残暴和 Orokin 的美学。当杀格 Prime 造成暴击时，其下一次射击有几率大幅提升触发几率。

descriptions.en: These twin barrels of destruction are the signature pistols of the Kuva Guardians.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TWIN ROGGA）这对能够带来破坏的枪管是赤毒守卫者手枪标志性的特征。

descriptions.en: Rain hell on the enemy with this handheld cluster-rocket launcher.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KULSTAR）使用这把手持集束火箭发射器，对敌人投以地狱之火。

descriptions.en: Inflict rapid-fire bursts of pain with this Grineer submachine gun.
descriptions.zh: （英文：STUBBA）用这把 Grineer 冲锋枪的爆发速射特性来产生相应的苦痛。

descriptions.en: This particle cannon generates a condensed beam of super-heated plasma designed to melt rock to ore, and enemies to molten slag.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ATOMOS）这把粒子加农炮能产生由超高温等离子体凝聚而成的射线。而这种射线可以用来冶炼矿石，也可以将敌人化为熔渣。

descriptions.en: The uniquely styled Viper Wraith is a powerful variation on the standard machine-pistol.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VIPER WRAITH）这把风格独一无二的蝰蛇·亡魂是基于制式机关手枪的强力变体。

descriptions.en: The uniquely styled Twin Vipers Wraith are a powerful variation on the standard akimbo machine-pistols.
descriptions.zh: （英文：WRAITH TWIN VIPERS）独特风格的双子蝰蛇·亡魂拥有比原版更强的火力。

descriptions.en: What the Aegrit lacks in quantity it makes up for in destructive power. Toss the Aegrit onto your enemy’s position then detonate remotely at the right moment for maximum destructive effect.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AEGRIT）骇敌榴弹虽然数量稀少但威力来补。将骇敌榴弹投掷到敌人的位置，然后在适当的时机远程引爆，以获得最大的破坏效果。

descriptions.en: Get the job done right with a pair of spore flinging terror tools. Inflicts a spore that spreads to nearby enemies on death causing <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status Effect and increased vulnerability to damage from the Torxica.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DUAL CODA TORXICA）用这对令人胆寒的孢子发射器完成任务。孢子感染会在敌人死亡时传播到附近的敌人身上，造成 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态，并且孢蚀双枪会更容易对这些敌人造成伤害。

descriptions.en: When the magazine reaches empty and is manually reloaded, the Coda Catabolyst launches not one but three powerful grenades. Also has a higher Status Chance, Damage, and Magazine Size.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CODA CATABOLYST）当弹匣空了并且手动重新装填时，终幕·异化者会发射三枚威力极大的手榴弹，而不是一枚。同时还具有更高的触发几率、伤害和弹匣容量。

descriptions.en: These festering, writhing, throwable projectiles of pus and gas have been improved with a greater Magazine Size, Critical Chance, Critical Damage, Status Chance, and Damage.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CODA POX）这些溃烂、扭动、可投掷的脓气投射物已得到改进，具有更高的弹匣容量、暴击几率、暴击伤害、触发几率和伤害。

descriptions.en: The Technocyte virus has contorted this Tysis into a more lethal weapon. With increased Damage, Critical Chance, Critical Damage and Magazine Capacity.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CODA TYSIS）科技细胞病毒将啐沫者扭曲成更致命的武器。伤害、暴击几率、暴击伤害和弹匣容量均有所提升。

descriptions.en: Splatter enemies with a short-range stream of corrosive bile and then toss the ammo bladder as a grenade when reloading. The emptier the pistol’s ammo bladder, the more potent its damage. A fully empty bladder packs the biggest punch.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CATABOLYST）可在短距离内向敌人喷射腐蚀性胆汁，此外，弹药囊腔可在装填时被用作投掷手雷。手枪的弹药囊腔越空，其造成的伤害就越强。完全射空的囊腔能发挥出最大的威力。

descriptions.en: These festering sacs of pus and gas burst violently on impact.
descriptions.zh: （英文：POX）受到冲击时，这些充满脓水和气体的溃烂脓包会剧烈地爆开。

descriptions.en: Infect your foes with this spore-scattering pistol. Headshots burrow in and explode, releasing spore clouds that seek out nearby enemies.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ZYMOS）用这件散射孢子的手枪来感染你的敌人。爆头射击会钻入敌人的体内并爆炸，释放出飘向附近敌人的孢子云。

descriptions.en: Brain-strikes excite this bioweapon, causing it to rapidly release toxic munitions.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DUAL TOXOCYST）对敌人造成爆头射击会刺激这把生物武器，能迅速发射毒素弹药。

descriptions.en: The Tysis pistol spits out caustic darts that corrode their victims from within.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TYSIS）啐沫者手枪借由喷吐出具有腐蚀性的毒镖，将受害者由内而外地侵蚀殆尽。

descriptions.en: A living weapon, the infested Embolist pistol kills its victims with an acidic venomous gas.
descriptions.zh: （英文：EMBOLIST）活生生的武器，被感染的安柏勒斯手枪用酸性有毒气体杀死受害者。

descriptions.en: The standard issue personal Efervon projector, as sported by all ranks of Scaldra.
descriptions.zh: （英文：EFV-8 MARS）标准的单兵艾弗旺喷射器，各个军衔的炽蛇军都配有此武器。

descriptions.en: A true masterpiece of Höllvanian engineering, Vesper 77's advanced laser sight highlights enemy Weak Points with precision. Aim to increase its Critical Damage Multiplier.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VESPER 77）夜语者 77 是霍瓦尼亚工程的真正杰作，其先进的激光瞄准器可突出显示敌人的弱点。瞄准来提高其暴击伤害倍率。

descriptions.en: The MK1-Furis are the standard issue automatic pistol for all Tenno.
descriptions.zh: （英文：MK1-FURIS）MK1-盗贼是给Tenno的标准配置自动手枪。

descriptions.en: The MK1-Kunai is the standard issue throwing knives for all Tenno.
descriptions.zh: （英文：MK1-KUNAI）MK1-苦无是给Tenno的标准配置投掷武器。

descriptions.en: A custom weapon made from many possible parts. Assembled by Rude Zuud in Fortuna and Father in the Necralisk.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KITGUN）一件由多个可供搭配的部件组成的武器。由福尔图娜的粗鲁的祖德和殁世幽都的"父亲"组装。

descriptions.en: A custom weapon made from many possible parts. Assembled by Rude Zuud in Fortuna and Father in the Necralisk.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KITGUN）一件由多个可供搭配的部件组成的武器。由福尔图娜的粗鲁的祖德和殁世幽都的"父亲"组装。

descriptions.en: A custom weapon made from many possible parts. Assembled by Rude Zuud in Fortuna and Father in the Necralisk.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KITGUN）一件由多个可供搭配的部件组成的武器。由福尔图娜的粗鲁的祖德和殁世幽都的"父亲"组装。

descriptions.en: For the Arbiters of Hexis these pistols are more than simple weapons, they are symbols of truth and discipline.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TELOS AKBOLTO）对均衡仲裁者来说，这对手枪不单只是寻常的武器，它们是真相与纪律的象征。

descriptions.en: Designed to quickly vaporize minerals for content analysis, users discovered its powerful beam was equally efficient at dispatching hostiles.
descriptions.zh: （英文：GAMMACOR）原为使矿物迅速蒸发以便于分析作业而设计，然而使用者却发现它强大的光束对于终结敌人也同样有效。

descriptions.en: Deployed by the Cephalon Suda, once a data-analyzing instrument the Gammacor main focus is defense.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SYNOID GAMMACOR）由中枢苏达所设置，过去曾作为数据分析仪器，但现在已转为专用于自卫的武器。

descriptions.en: This remotely detonated electrical trap is used by devotees of New Loka to protect their temples and shrines.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SANCTI CASTANAS ）这种能遥控引爆的电击陷阱是新世间的信徒用来保护他们的寺庙与圣殿的武器。

descriptions.en: The favored side-arms of Perrin Sequence executives, these pistols have been modified to improve efficiency and killing potential.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SECURA DUAL CESTRA）受佩兰数列高层人员青睐的贴身武器，这对手枪已经过改造来提升效率与击杀潜力。

descriptions.en: This modified ballistica is the weapon of choice used by Red Veil Assassins to take out high-priority marks.
descriptions.zh: （英文：RAKTA BALLISTICA）这把经过改造的布里斯提卡是血色面纱的刺客用来解决高度优先目标的首选武器。

descriptions.en: Taken from defeated Grineer commanders and rebuilt to improve combat efficiency and reliability.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VAYKOR MARELOK）取自于战败的 Grineer 指挥官，并经过重构来提升作战效率和可靠性。

descriptions.en: Dual Lex pistols double the amount of high caliber lead you can throw at the enemy, but accuracy and reload time suffer.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKLEX）以雷克斯双枪的两只大口径枪管朝敌人开火，但精准度和装填时间会受到负面影响。

descriptions.en: Savage the enemy with a Lex Prime in each hand.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKLEX PRIME）双手各持一把雷克斯 Prime 猛攻敌人。

descriptions.en: Furis pistols equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and slightly faster Fire Rate, but Accuracy and Reload Speed are lowered.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AFURIS）双手各装备一把盗贼手枪，具有两倍的弹匣容量与稍快的射速，但精准度会下降，且换弹的速度增长。

descriptions.en: A Bolto equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and slightly faster Fire Rate, but reload time is doubled and accuracy is lowered.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKBOLTO）双手各装备一把螺钉手枪，具有两倍的弹匣容量与稍快的射速，但精准度会下降，且需两倍的换弹时间。

descriptions.en: A Lato equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and Fire Rate, but Reload time is doubled and Accuracy is lowered.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKLATO）每只手持一把拉托，双倍弹匣和射速，但双倍装填时间，且精度更差。

descriptions.en: A Bronco equipped in each hand.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKBRONCO）双手各持一把野马。

descriptions.en: A Viper equipped in each hand.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TWIN VIPERS）每只手持一把蝰蛇。

descriptions.en: Twice the ammo and twice the stopping power of a single Magnus.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKMAGNUS）和一把麦格努斯相比有双倍弹药和双倍后坐力。

descriptions.en: Fill your fists with golden cannons of fury. This refined design unlocks quicker handling and higher critical chance.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKMAGNUS PRIME）给你的拳中塞上这愤怒的金色教条。这种精良的设计可加快操作速度并提高暴击几率。

descriptions.en: Vasto revolvers equipped in each hand.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKVASTO）双手各持一把瓦斯托左轮手枪。

descriptions.en: Used together, these Orokin pistols feed off each other, inflicting greater damage with an enhanced status chance for inducing elemental effects on targets.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKBRONCO PRIME）同时使用这两把相辅相成的奥罗金手枪 ，以更高的元素触发几率，来对目标造成更大的伤害。

descriptions.en:
A more accurate variation of the Nosam Cutter.

Travel far from Hub settlements for the best chance of mining rare minerals.
descriptions.zh:
一款更精准的诺萨姆切割器变体。

远离城镇中心，将有更高几率开采出稀有矿物。

descriptions.en:
Enhanced with cybernetics, this tool is able to locate nearby gems and ore veins and has chance to retrieve Rare Gems on any Landscape.

Travel far from Hub settlements for the best chance of mining rare minerals.
descriptions.zh:
经过控制理论的升级，这把工具能够定位附近的宝石和矿脉，并有几率在任何地形中获取稀有宝石。

远离城镇中心，将有更高几率开采出稀有矿物。

descriptions.en:
Fast-ignition, high-intensity mining tool capable of extracting the rarest of materials with surgical precision.

Can be used to retrieve Rare Gems on any Landscape. Travel far from Hub settlements for the best chance of mining rare minerals.
descriptions.zh:
这是一把快速点火、高强度的采矿工具，能够以外科手术般的精确度开采最稀有的矿物。

可在任何地形中获取稀有宝石。远离城镇中心，将有更高几率开采出稀有矿物。

descriptions.en:
Standard tool for cutting ore and gems out of stone.

Travel far from Hub settlements for the best chance of mining rare minerals.
descriptions.zh:
从石头中切割矿石和宝石的标准的工具。

远离城镇中心，将有更高几率开采出稀有矿物。

descriptions.en: Claim the power of Albrecht Entrati's knowledge. Customize the Grimoire with Tome Mods that enhance Warframe Abilities and reward strategic combat. Its alternate attack releases a voltaic orb with guaranteed <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Status.
descriptions.zh: （英文：GRIMOIRE）获取阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的全知之力。使用典籍 Mod 增强战甲技能并获得战术优势。次要射击发射一颗必定造成 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击异常状态的电弧球。

descriptions.en: Claim the power of Albrecht Entrati's knowledge. Customize the Grimoire with Tome Mods that enhance Warframe Abilities and reward strategic combat. Its alternate attack releases a voltaic orb with guaranteed <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Status.
descriptions.zh: （英文：GRIMOIRE）获取阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的全知之力。使用典籍 Mod 增强战甲技能并获得战术优势。次要射击发射一颗必定造成 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击异常状态的电弧球。

descriptions.en: The Furis delivers a high damage output in a short time frame thanks to its high rate of fire.
descriptions.zh: （英文：FURIS）盗贼是一把自动手枪，这小东西拥有极高的射速。

descriptions.en: The Furis delivers a high damage output in a short time frame thanks to its high rate of fire.
descriptions.zh: （英文：FURIS）盗贼是一把自动手枪，这小东西拥有极高的射速。

descriptions.en: Infused with rare Orokin alloys, the Bronco Prime is a highly efficient weapon, trading an increased Magazine Capacity and damage for a lower rate of fire.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BRONCO PRIME）加入罕见的奥罗金合金，野马 Prime 是一把高效能武器，以射速为代价，提高装弹量和伤害力。

descriptions.en: The Sicarus fires 3-round bursts, which provides a balance between the lethality of auto-pistols and the accuracy of semi-automatic pistols.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SICARUS）暗杀者是三发点射手枪，在连发手枪的杀伤力和单发手枪的准确度之间取得平衡。

descriptions.en: The Lato is a highly accurate pistol used by the Tenno everywhere.
descriptions.zh: （英文：LATO）拉托是一款被 Tenno 广泛使用的高精度手枪。

descriptions.en: The Bolto fires slow, heavy bolts that are capable of impaling enemies to walls.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BOLTO）螺钉手枪连射速度缓慢，大型的螺钉能把敌人钉在墙上。

descriptions.en: The Bronco is a small-scale shotgun that can be wielded with one hand. Only effective at close range, it has a limited Magazine Capacity.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BRONCO）野马是可以单手操作的小型霰弹枪。在近距离有效但弹匣容量较少。

descriptions.en: The Bronco is a small-scale shotgun that can be wielded with one hand. Only effective at close range, it has a limited Magazine Capacity.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BRONCO）野马是可以单手操作的小型霰弹枪。在近距离有效但弹匣容量较少。

descriptions.en: The Lex is a powerful, accurate pistol that has a low Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity. Very efficient at long range.
descriptions.zh: （英文：LEX）雷克斯是大火力的手枪，射速和弹匣容量都很低，但每发伤害很高。

descriptions.en: The Lex is a powerful, accurate pistol that has a low Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity. Very efficient at long range.
descriptions.zh: （英文：LEX）雷克斯是大火力的手枪，射速和弹匣容量都很低，但每发伤害很高。

descriptions.en: The Lato is a highly accurate pistol used by the Tenno everywhere. Prime model offers slightly increased damage.
descriptions.zh: （英文：LATO PRIME）拉托是半自动手枪。其高精度深受 Tenno 喜爱。PRIME 版本拥有稍高的伤害。

descriptions.en: A special version of the standard Lato pistol with a slower Fire Rate but offering higher Accuracy and Damage values. The Lato Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding on the grips.
descriptions.zh: （英文：LATO VANDAL）拉托的特别版，射速略低但伤害和精准度更高。拉托·破坏者被 Tenno 定制成蓝绿色金属光泽，并在握把上绘制了 Lotus 纹样。

descriptions.en: The Lato is a highly accurate pistol used by the Tenno everywhere.
descriptions.zh: （英文：LATO）拉托是一款被 Tenno 广泛使用的高精度手枪。

descriptions.en: The Lato is a highly accurate pistol used by the Tenno everywhere.
descriptions.zh: （英文：LATO）拉托是一款被 Tenno 广泛使用的高精度手枪。

descriptions.en: Steady and reliable, the Vasto revolver combines speed and power for a classic gunslinger feel.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VASTO）稳定、可靠。这把瓦斯托左轮手枪结合了速度与力量，呈现出经典的神枪手意象。

descriptions.en: Never stop fighting, never run out of ammo. Temple's signature machine pistol was modified by Albrecht Entrati to warp fired bullets back into the magazine when reloaded.
descriptions.zh: （英文：RIOT-848）弹药无穷无尽，战斗至死方休。Temple 的标志性连发手枪经过阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的改造，装填时，被消耗的子弹会重新回到弹匣中。

descriptions.en: Banshee Prime's signature shotgun is an instrument of devastation that fires both focused and broad shots.
descriptions.zh: （英文：EUPHONA PRIME）Banshee Prime 的标志性霰弹枪是把可射出集中和散射子弹的破坏性武器。

descriptions.en: The Ballistica crossbow features a unique dual firing mechanism. Choose between a four bolt volley or a deadly accurate charged shot.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BALLISTICA）这把布里斯提卡连弩采用独特的双击发装置，可在四连发或蓄力使用精准的致命射击之间选择。

descriptions.en: Hammer the enemy with this light-bodied heavy hitter. Featuring a double-action trigger that fires hard and fast.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ZYLOK）用这把轻盈的重击手猛击敌人。具有复动式扳机，可以快速、猛烈地发射。

descriptions.en: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DEX FURIS）这是 Lotus 为第一位从低温催眠中醒来的 Tenno 所准备的一份周年纪念礼物。
（英文：AKSONDOL）Narin 的标志性手枪威力十足，如同凛冬的寒风。每次装填都会释放出一道寒冷的脉冲，使敌人陷入冰冻异常状态，脉冲的范围会随着装填次数的增加而扩大。

descriptions.en: The choice weapon of Mirage, these fast-firing dual pistols deliver a deadly performance.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKZANI）作为 Mirage 的精选武器，这些高射速的双手枪将为您带来一场致命的演出。

descriptions.en: The versatile Magnus revolver is a lethal sidearm for any Tenno.
descriptions.zh: （英文：MAGNUS）多功能麦格努斯左轮手枪对于任何 Tenno 来说都是一把能置对手于死地的手枪。

descriptions.en: Vanquish chaos with dual firepower.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AFURIS PRIME）以双重火力征服混乱。

descriptions.en: Wield a golden pair of rocket launchers. Sprint to reload them faster. They reload fastest when wielded by Gauss.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKARIUS PRIME）挥舞一对金色火箭发射器。冲刺时可以拥有更快的装填速度。搭配 Gauss 使用时，其装填速度更快。

descriptions.en: Gilded rails adorn these two vicious bolt launching pistols.
descriptions.zh: （英文：Akbolto Prime）镀金的导轨装饰着这对凶猛的钉枪。

descriptions.en: Precision machined mirrored pistols. Primed and ready.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKJAGARA PRIME）精密加工的镜像手枪。填装完毕并蓄势待发。

descriptions.en: The elegant Aksomati precisely refined to this, their ultimate manifestation.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKSOMATI PRIME）优雅的轻灵月神双枪精准定义了它们的终极表现。

descriptions.en: Stylish, discreet and accurate, perfect for the Tenno of distinction.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKSTILETTO PRIME）时尚、稳定而精准，非常适合那些喜欢与众不同的 Tenno 们。

descriptions.en: Unleash the song of the righteous warrior with this gilded pistol that goes into Overdrive on headshot kills, maximizing fire rate and ammo efficiency for a short time.
descriptions.zh: 用这把镀金手枪释放正义战士的怒吼，弱点击杀后即可进入超负荷模式，短时间内大幅提升射速和弹药效率。

descriptions.en: The beauty of this luxuriously gilded crossbow cannot obscure its lethal purpose.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BALLISTICA PRIME）这款豪华镀金连弩的精美无法遮掩它致命的目的。

descriptions.en: Send shivers down your enemies' spines with this wrist-mounted sidearm. As the signature weapon of Sevagoth Prime, it deals additional headshot damage when wielded by him.
descriptions.zh: （英文：EPITAPH PRIME）这把腕式次要武器让你的敌人不寒而栗。作为 Sevagoth Prime 的标志性武器，由他使用时可造成额外的爆头伤害。

descriptions.en: Versatile weapons complement deadly hunters. Khora Prime’s signature pistol rotates through hot, cold, electric, and toxic quills. When equipped on Khora, Hystrix Prime has a chance to instantly reload after headshots.
descriptions.zh: （英文：HYSTRIX PRIME）灵活多变的武器与致命的猎人相得益彰。Khora Prime 的标志性手枪可在火焰、冰冻、电击和毒素刺镖中轮换。当 Khora 装备上豪猪 Prime 并造成爆头时，则弹药有几率立即重新装填。

descriptions.en: Ring a funeral toll upon enemy skulls with Harrow Prime's signature pistol.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KNELL PRIME）用 Harrow Prime 的标志性手枪在敌人的头颅上敲响葬礼的钟声。

descriptions.en: Glinting like a golden dawn, Yareli Prime’s signature pistol engulfs foes in a cascade of virulent, explosive, water globules. None can escape the sea.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KOMPRESSA PRIME）Yareli Prime 的标志性手枪闪耀着金色黎明般的光芒，将敌人吞噬在一连串的剧毒、爆炸性水弹中。没有人能逃出这片水域。

descriptions.en: The Lex Prime is a powerful, accurate pistol that has a low Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity. Very efficient at long range.
descriptions.zh: （英文：LEX PRIME）雷克斯 Prime 是一把强大且精准的手枪，虽然有着射速慢和弹匣小的缺点，但在远距离作战时非常出色。

descriptions.en: Orokin elegance meets formidable stopping power in this exquisite revolver. Hits have a chance to maximize Ammo Efficiency for a few seconds.
descriptions.zh: （英文：MAGNUS PRIME）奥罗金的优雅与强大制动力在这把精致的左轮手枪中相遇。命中时有几率在数秒内最大化弹药效率。

descriptions.en: Pound the beat for a dance of death with Octavia's signature prime pistol.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PANDERO PRIME）以这把 Octavia 的标志性 Prime 手枪，为死亡之舞敲奏节拍。

descriptions.en: Three kills in rapid succession to summon a second ethereal Pyrana for twice the deadly punch.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PYRANA PRIME）快速地连续 3 次击杀将召唤一把食人鱼的幻影，造成双倍的致命杀伤。

descriptions.en: The Sicarus Prime is an ornamental firearm that fires rounds in rapid bursts, providing a balance between the lethality of auto-pistols and the accuracy of semi-automatic pistols.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SICARUS PRIME）暗杀者 PRIME 是一把快速点射的装饰性武器，在连发手枪的杀伤力和单发手枪的准确度之间取得平衡。

descriptions.en: Orokin craftsmanship married with superior firepower. Dual Vastos, primed and ready to strike.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKVASTO PRIME）奥罗金精湛工艺与出众火力的结合。两把瓦斯托，已经装弹待发。

descriptions.en: This elegant rapid-fire revolver is the embodiment of superior Orokin craftsmanship.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VASTO PRIME）这把优雅的速射左轮手枪，正是奥罗金卓越工艺设计的体现。

descriptions.en: This sidearm’s circular design evokes Protea Prime’s perception of time.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VELOX PRIME）这把次要武器的圆形设计唤起了 Protea Prime 对时间的感知。

descriptions.en: A thousand pains, before their end.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ZAKTI PRIME）在他们临终之前，使其受尽千般痛苦。

descriptions.en: A lightweight weapon that packs a punch worthy of its golden design.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ZYLOK PRIME）看似轻巧的武器，却有着与其金色设计相称的巨大威力。

descriptions.en: Heat, cold, electricity, or toxin: choose an element and launch a flurry of deadly quills. This versatile sidearm is Khora’s signature weapon and has a chance to instantly reload after headshots when she wields it.
descriptions.zh: （英文：HYSTRIX）火焰、冰冻、电击或者毒素：选择一种元素并发射出一簇簇致命的刺镖。这款灵活多变的次要武器是 Khora 的标志性武器。当她使用豪猪时，爆头有几率使弹药重新装填。

descriptions.en: Bombard legions of enemies with target seeking rockets. These dual launchers reload faster while sprinting, even more so in Gauss’ hands. Rockets arm after reaching a safe distance.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKARIUS）使用目标追踪火箭弹轰击成群的敌人。冲刺时可以更快地装填弹匣，在 Gauss 手里效果更加显著。火箭会在离开安全距离后爆炸。

descriptions.en: Chew through the enemy with this vicious automatic hand shotgun.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PYRANA）用这把凶恶的自动霰弹手枪咬穿敌人。

descriptions.en: The devastating power of the Soma rifle compacted into two elegant pistols.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKSOMATI ）月神步枪的强大威力被凝聚在这对优雅的手枪当中。

descriptions.en: This intricate automatic pistol is able to fire its magazine which then spins in the air for a short time, firing lasers at nearby enemies.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AZIMA）这把构造错综复杂的自动手枪能射出其弹匣，同时在空中旋转的弹匣短时间内会击发激光攻击附近的敌人。

descriptions.en: These diminutive rapid-fire Stiletto machine-pistols are just the right size to be akimbo style without sacrificing accuracy.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKSTILETTO）这对小巧，能快速击发的史提托全自动手枪，其恰如其分的尺寸既能双持射击又不失精准度。

descriptions.en: The design of these hard-hitting dual pistols is a mix of organic and bladed elements.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKJAGARA）这组重击双手枪的设计是有机体和刀片元素的结合。

descriptions.en: Octavia's pistol hammers foes with single shots or a rapid volley of bullets. When wielded by Octavia, alt-fire Headshot Kills increase Reload Speed.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PANDERO）Octavia 的手枪以单发或迅速齐发的方式将子弹打入敌人体内。在被 Octavia 使用时，由次要射击所造成的爆头击杀会提升装填速度。

descriptions.en: Fires razor-sharp darts that anchor themselves in their target before erupting in a plume of toxic gas.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ZAKTI）可以发射如剃刀般锋利的飞镖固定在目标上，接着喷发出一股有毒气体。

descriptions.en: Reverse-engineered from propulsion tech this hand-cannon packs a kick. Weak Point kills trigger Overdrive, locking off secondary functions while maximizing your fire rate and ammo efficiency for a short time.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ATHODAI）这款强力手枪由喷射推进器技术逆向设计而成。弱点击杀会触发超载状态，该状态将禁用次要射击，并在短时间内最大化你的射速和弹药效率。

descriptions.en: With a high fire rate, ammo efficiency and rapid reload when emptied, this unusual sidearm can hand out carnage all day long. Ammo efficiency is further increased when Protea uses this, her signature weapon.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VELOX）在高射速、高弹药效率以及高装填速度的加持下，这把非比寻常的次要武器能昼夜无休地大杀四方。作为 Protea 的标志性武器，弹药效率会在 Protea 使用它时更进一步地提升。

descriptions.en: Ring the death knell. Headshots briefly turn this scoped pistol into a rapid-fire, Critical Damage fiend that uses no ammo. When used by Harrow, Knell has a 2-round mag.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KNELL）鸣响死神的丧钟。爆头射击短暂地将这把带瞄准镜的手枪变成快速击发，不消耗弹药的暴击伤害恶魔。在被 Harrow 使用时，丧钟会拥有双发弹匣。

descriptions.en: Sevagoth's wrist-mounted sidearm fires a chilling slow-moving slab, guaranteed to slow enemies for easier marksmanship. Charge the shot to fire a punishing high-velocity, high critical chance slab that punches through barriers. Deals additional headshot damage in Sevagoth's hands.
descriptions.zh: （英文：EPITAPH）Sevagoth 的腕式次要武器可以发射令人胆寒的慢速移动石板，石板可以减缓敌人的速度，以更轻松地瞄准敌人。蓄力射击可发射一个惩戒性的高速、高暴击几率的石板，石板可击穿障碍物。在 Sevagoth 手中可造成额外的爆头伤害。

descriptions.en: Launch a volley of virulent, hyper-pressurized, water globules that envelope targets and explode with torrential force. Yareli's signature pistol.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KOMPRESSA）发射一连串的剧毒高压水弹，包围目标并剧烈爆炸。Yareli 的标志性手枪。

descriptions.en: Silently lacerate enemies with Gara's signature glass throwing knives. Increased Projectile Speed when wielded by Gara.
descriptions.zh: （英文：FUSILAI）无声地以 Gara 的标志性玻璃飞刀撕裂敌人。在被 Gara 使用时，该武器的投射物飞行速度会提升。

descriptions.en: Kunai throwing daggers offer a silent alternative to the traditional side arm. Perfect for assassins.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUNAI）苦无以投掷用匕首替代传统次要武器的非静音攻击。暗杀首选。

descriptions.en: A flash of red ribbon is the last thing most victims of these throwing-daggers see.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SPIRA）彤红缎带的残影，是这款投掷匕首刃下大多数受害者最后看到的影像。

descriptions.en: These rare, braided throwing daggers were a favorite tool of high ranking Orokin assassins.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SPIRA PRIME）配置这些罕见的投掷匕首，是奥罗金高阶刺客喜欢的工具。

descriptions.en: As deadly as any bullet without the associated noise or commotion.
descriptions.zh: （英文：HIKOU PRIME）如同任何子弹一样致命，且不会引起噪音或骚动。

descriptions.en: Used by The Stalker, Despair throwing blades have a mono-filament edge, sharp enough to penetrate a Warframe.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DESPAIR）追猎者所持的绝望，是丢出由单分子构成的刀刃，足够锋利来穿透战甲。

descriptions.en: The remotely triggered Castanas quietly deliver a lethal dose of electricity to unsuspecting enemies.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CASTANAS）可远程遥控的雷爆信镖会悄悄传递致死剂量的电力给毫无戒备的敌人。

descriptions.en: As an alternative to Kunai, these Tenno throwing stars do cause less Damage but they come with expanded Ammo Capacity and a higher Fire Rate.
descriptions.zh: （英文：HIKOU）作为苦无的替代方案，飞扬用较低的伤害换得更高的携带量跟更快的射速。

descriptions.en:
In moments of despair, let the battle resonate with song. Cantare's blades lodge into the battlefield and return upon reload. When returning blades strike enemies, Cantare empowers allies with increased Reload Speed.

Experience the true power of Jade's Ensemble when Evensong, Cantare, and Harmony sing together.
descriptions.zh:
在绝望的时刻，让歌声响彻战场。歌颂的刃片会扎入战场中，并在重新装填时返回。当返回的刃片击中敌人时，歌颂会增强友军的装填速度。

当晚祷、歌颂与和谐一同奏响时，体验 Jade 之合奏真正的力量。

descriptions.en: Go on the hunt with Oraxia’s signature secondary. Fling a volley of toxin-laced barbs, or drop a cluster snare that scatters on impact, seizing nearby enemies and dragging them together.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SCYOTID）使用 Oraxia 的标志性次要武器进行狩猎。你可以射出一连串充满毒素的倒钩，或者投放一个在撞击时散开的团状陷阱，抓住附近的敌人并将其拖到一起。

descriptions.en: The claws of these tactical bombs dig into the target and detonate on command.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TALONS）附带的尖锐勾爪能将战术炸弹掘入目标体内并遥控引爆。

descriptions.en: May contain rocks.
descriptions.zh: 可能包含有岩石。

descriptions.en: As an alternative to Kunai, these Tenno throwing stars do cause less Damage but they come with expanded Ammo Capacity and a higher Fire Rate.
descriptions.zh: （英文：HIKOU）作为苦无的替代方案，飞扬用较低的伤害换得更高的携带量跟更快的射速。

descriptions.en: During parades and victory marches, the Laetum fired pigmented airburst rounds that rained onto festive crowds. The Orokin sent Laetum with the Zariman so they could properly celebrate a successful maiden voyage to Tau. There would be no such celebration, but the Void imbued the Laetum with a much more explosive capacity.
descriptions.zh: （英文：LAETUM）在阅兵式和得胜行军期间，人们会用奏凯发射色彩缤纷的空爆弹化作鲜艳的雨点落在欢庆的人群身上。奥罗金人将奏凯送上了「扎里曼号」，以便他们能够好好庆祝前往 Tau 星系的成功首航。虽然这样的庆祝活动从未发生，但虚空给奏凯赋予了更强的爆炸之力。

descriptions.en: Albrecht's Void experiments revealed the true destructive potential of this weapon. In Incarnon form, draw in ambient power to deal steadily increased damage to enemies. At full power, release a blast of <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ONOS）阿尔布雷希特的虚空实验揭示了这把武器的真正破坏潜力。在灵化形态下，吸收周围的能量对敌人造成逐渐增加的伤害。当能量充满时，释放一股 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰爆炸。

descriptions.en: An ancient weapon designed by the Entrati. Primary fire siphons life essence from the target to fuel a devastating secondary fire. This large, weighty double-barreled pistol delivers twin projectiles that pack a punch, exploding on impact. Secondary fire puts the weapon in lock-on mode. Aim to lock onto multiple targets, then fire to unleash homing projectiles.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SEPULCRUM）一把由英择谛所设计的古老武器。主要射击可从目标身上吸取生命精华，以助燃次要射击带来的毁灭性攻击。这把大且沉的双管手枪可发出双股投射弹药，并在撞击时产生强力爆炸。次要射击会将手枪置于锁定状态，可追踪多个目标，并释放制导弹药。

descriptions.en: For Orokin-era smugglers, this fearsome handheld shotgun was a favored tool for 'dispute resolution'.
descriptions.zh: （英文：MARA DETRON）对于奥罗金时代的走私者来说，这把令人生畏的手持式霰弹枪是最受他们青睐用来"解决纠纷"的工具。
